Settings.WebhooksDescription: HTTP endpoints notified when a transcription completes. Each transcription has 10 seconds to reach all webhooks. A webhook is retried once, only when it refused the request or could not be reached. Redirects are not followed.
Settings.Name: Name
Settings.ProfileFilterDescription: One profile name per line. Used with 'Only the listed profiles'.
Settings.UrlInvalid: URL must be a valid absolute http:// or https:// URL.
Settings.MethodInvalid: method must be POST or PUT.
Settings.HeaderMissingSeparator: header line '{0}' is missing a ':' separator.
Settings.HeaderEmptyName: header line '{0}' has an empty name.
Settings.HeaderPlaceholderWithoutStoredV: header '{0}' has no stored value to keep; enter its real value.
Settings.ProfileModeAll: All profiles and dictation without a profile
Settings.ProfileModeInvalid: the profile choice must be all profiles or the listed profiles.
Settings.ProfilesWithAllMode: choose 'Only the listed profiles' to use the profile list, or clear the list.
Settings.ProfilesRequired: list at least one profile, or choose all profiles.
Settings.ProfileUnknown: profile '{0}' does not exist. Available profiles: {1}.
Settings.ProfileUnknownNoProfiles: profile '{0}' does not exist, and no profiles are defined yet.
Settings.UrlCredentials: the URL must not contain a user name or password; send credentials in a header.
Actions.TestDescription: Sends a sample message to the saved webhook, even when it is disabled. Save your changes first.
Actions.TestWebhookChanged: This webhook was changed or removed. Save, then try again.
Outcome.HeaderSecretUnavailable: A stored header value is unavailable; enter it again.
Manifest.Name: Webhook
Manifest.Description: Sends event notifications to a webhook URL
